# Instructions for accurately documenting personal information in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the tax returns of the company and its directors.
2. Highlight the transactions and record entries relevant to the personal income and financial liabilities of the directors based on their tax returns.

What are the most significant business losses experienced by the company in the past few years?
What are the personal income and financial liabilities of the company's directors?
Avoid making unwarranted assumptions. Only provide facts-based information.<eos>
